idea-plugin.name: Kokedera - Moss Temple Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Kokedera - Moss Temple Theme

A dark moss-temple color theme — forest greens, weathered stone, soft lantern light.

Philosophy

Rooted in restraint — beauty in imperfection, transience, and the incomplete. No color shouts or demands attention. A quiet space where code can breathe.

Color Metaphors

  • Editor background — Deep shade beneath ancient trees
  • Keywords — Sunlight catching the brightest moss
  • Strings — Warm amber of paper lanterns at dusk
  • Comments — Weathered stone inscriptions softened by time
  • Types — Dark green cedars standing tall
  • Functions — Fresh bamboo swaying in a gentle breeze
